messages:
Aisha: Quick check — from INC-934 postmortem I pulled the action items that cross teams. Need owners + firm due dates so we can close the RCA. Table below; pls ack or reassign. I'll collate by EOD.

Actions:
- DB validation (verify migration + backfill safety)
- Roll-forward plan (canary + rollback criteria)
- KV-cache schema bump (compat checks)
- Playbook update (oncall steps + runbook)
- QA regression tests (smoke + perf)

Aisha: I'll start: DB validation — unassigned.

Jon: I can take DB validation. Target due Fri 2025-04-11 EOD. :+1:

Priya: I can own Roll-forward plan. Need infra gating for canary traffic split — pinging @Ben in eng-infra. Due Mon 2025-04-14.

Ben: @Priya Ack — I'll schedule the gating work. Blocker: infra ticket <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4567> needs approval from infra-arch. ETA Thu noon.

Carla: I'll take Playbook update. Can we be explicit about steps for partial rollback? I can draft by Tue 2025-04-15. Also need QA test cases for regression — looping in @Maya.

Maya: I can do QA regression tests but need a stable test dataset. @Jon can you confirm the backfill won't modify historical rows older than 2024-01-01? If yes I can lock test data and run smoke+perf by Wed 2025-04-16.

Jon: Confirmed — backfill scope excludes rows before 2024-01-01. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Reminder: INC-934 RCA action-owner assignments due in 48 hours.

Priya: Re KV-cache schema bump — that looks like it touches eng-runtime teams. @Liam can you confirm compatibility matrix? (cc @eng-runtime)

Liam: I'll validate compatibility. Expect a short run and results by Fri 2025-04-11. If anything breaks we'll highlight the exact models affected.

Carla: Noted — I've added all due dates to the RCA doc and linked it here: <https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-934/rca-actions> Will update owners column.

Aisha: Thanks everyone. If you're taking an action but need more time, reply with new ETA. I'll do a final sweep tomorrow morning and escalate any unassigned items. :thumbsup:
